tools.name: validate_repository
tools.description: Validates governed repository artifacts and enforcement rules.
tools.when_to_use: Before a loop starts and before completion.
tools.returns: A structured list of validation issues.
tools.example: Validate the repository before opening a pull request.

tools.name: create_ticket
tools.description: Creates a bounded ticket from the governed template.
tools.when_to_use: After an accepted requirement and spec acceptance criterion exist.
tools.returns: The created ticket path and stable ID.
tools.example: Create TICKET-014 for one acceptance criterion.

tools.name: start_loop
tools.description: Starts one approved and validated ticket loop.
tools.when_to_use: When a ready ticket has valid links, scope, and required approval.

tools.name: record_event
tools.description: Appends a validated and redacted workflow event.
tools.when_to_use: At every governed lifecycle or execution transition.

parameters.name: metadata
parameters.server_validation: Redact sensitive keys and reject unsupported fields.

tools.name: update_trace
tools.description: Updates a requirement trace record while preserving stable IDs.
tools.when_to_use: Whenever behavior or linked verification changes.

tools.name: archive_ticket
tools.description: Archives completed work and closes its trace status.
tools.when_to_use: After completion evidence and metrics exist.
tools.returns: The archive path and event ID.

parameters.name: ticket_id
parameters.server_validation: Require a complete or cancelled ticket.

tools.name: validate_product_chain
tools.description: Validates outcome, opportunity, bet, milestone, PRD, change-request, and review links.
tools.when_to_use: Before approving a bet, planning a PRD, or closing a milestone.
tools.returns: A structured list of broken or incomplete product links.
tools.example: Reject a PRD whose parent bet is not validated.

tools.name: export_product_views
tools.description: Generates non-canonical requirement, acceptance, and CSV trace views from canonical sources.
tools.when_to_use: After PRD, spec, or trace changes.
tools.returns: Generated paths or drift failures in check mode.

tools.name: evaluate_product_gate
tools.description: Checks whether one PRD has a validated outcome-to-bet chain.
tools.when_to_use: Before a PRD advances into milestone planning.
tools.returns: Pass or a list of blocking upstream defects.

tools.name: record_product_review
tools.description: Records the human decision for a milestone or release.
tools.returns: The stable REVIEW-NNN record and lifecycle event.
